messages:
Alex: Hey team — a new user reported that the Flutter quickstart prints a 200 but nothing streams in the app, only after they toggle the workspace billing checkbox in the console does streaming start.
Maria: whoa, 200 but no stream? do they get the full response later or nothing at all?
Alex: nothing. app shows the request completed but the streaming handler never receives chunks. curl to the same workspace returns streaming chunks immediately.
Sam (devex): Can you paste the exact curl + Flutter client logs? might be TLS/alpn issue or the SDK swallowing a non-200 upgrade handshake.
Alex: snippets: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx" \nhttps://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'```
and Flutter logs: "INFO: request completed: 200 OK" then `onData` never called.
Mel: Is the workspace on a trial? any unusual billing state?
Alex: Yes — they said "trial pending" in the console, not an active trial. The BillingBot even posted a banner: "Trial needs activation" but the user said they didn't click it because they thought 200 meant success.
BillingBot: If workspace billing is not activated, webhooks/streaming are rate-limited to a single non-streaming response. See /billing for details.
Maria: Interesting — server returned 200 (so client thought success) but backend actually sent a short non-stream payload. Flutter SDK relies on chunked transfer to trigger stream callbacks, while curl shows transfer-encoding: chunked.
Sam (devex): Hypothesis: when billing not active we fast-finish the response with 200 + final payload without chunked encoding for compatibility, which confuses clients expecting a streaming handshake. We should either return a clear 402/4xx or keep the handshake semantics but include an error envelope.
Olivia (ux): From a UX perspective, showing a banner in console isn't enough if the SDK surface silently behaves differently. New users expect the sample app to either stream or show an error. We should improve messaging and the quickstart flow.
Alex: Repro steps attached by user: 1) create org via SSO 2) invite user 3) don't accept billing prompt 4) run Flutter quickstart 5) logs show 200 but no stream.
Sam (devex): Quick mitigation: make the Flutter and JS quickstart SDKs detect non-chunked final responses and surface a clear error like "billing_inactive: workspace billing required for streaming" instead of treating as normal success.
Maria: Agreed. Also add server side: when billing inactive, return 402 Payment Required or 403 with structured json error for non-stream endpoints. For streams, keep the HTTP status 402 and include an explanatory chunk so clients can show the error immediately.
Mel: Can we also gate the sample app template to check billing status in the quickstart flow and surface a pre-flight message? e.g., call /workspaces/me and show a toast if trial not active.
Olivia (ux): I'll propose UI copy: "Activate trial to enable streaming and large responses — click here to add payment method or request trial activation."
Sam (devex): Action items: 1) backend: change inactive-billing behavior for streaming to explicit 402 with a short error chunk (sam -> infra), 2) SDKs: detect non-chunked streaming responses and raise billing_inactive error (maria -> devex-sdk), 3) quickstart app: add preflight billing check + clearer onboarding copy (olivia -> devex-dx), 4) docs: add troubleshooting note about "200 but no stream" (alex -> docs).
Alex: I'll add a failing user reproduction case to Sentry and attach the user's logs.
Maria: I'll open a PR for Node/Flutter SDKs with a quick heuristic (if content-length present and response body short but request was stream-type, raise billing_inactive).
Mel: Noted. Also let's add a small telemetry event so we can count how many new workspaces hit this and whether it's causing sign-up dropoff.
Olivia (ux): I'll draft the console banner tweak and the quickstart modal copy.
Sam (devex): Thanks. We should post a short note in #announcements once the SDK patch is published so community doesn't get confused.
Alex: Thanks all — I'll update thread when PRs land. :thumbsup:
